# Afflictions

Add afflictions to your mod, like the game's Diseased or Chest Wound. A unit's afflictions show on its unit stats screen, and you give each one its effect in your mod's Lua script. [Limits](limits.md#afflictions) has how many afflictions mods can add.

!!! info "More in the game's manual"
    Vanilla affliction commands are in Illwinter's official modding manual, under ["Events"](https://www.illwinter.com/coe5/coe5modding.pdf#page=38) and ["Ritual Modding"](https://www.illwinter.com/coe5/coe5modding.pdf#page=33).

### newaffliction "&lt;name&gt;" <span class="new-badge">New</span> { #newaffliction .command data-toc-label="newaffliction" data-added="3.6" }

Creates an affliction. Its `descr` (the text the player reads by clicking it on the unit stats screen), `icon`, and `battleaff` follow it, then `end`.

- **name:** In double quotes, as the unit stats screen shows it. Mods using the same name share the affliction.

A Lua script gives it its effect with `coe5.afflictionEffect` ([`coe5_calls.lua`](https://github.com/musical-pianist/coe5se/blob/main/coe5_calls.lua) documents every call).

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    #!@newaffliction "Marsh Fever"
    #!@descr "A fever from the foul airs of the Dead Marshes."
    #!@battleaff
    #!@end
    ```

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    newaffliction "Marsh Fever"
    descr "A fever from the foul airs of the Dead Marshes."
    battleaff
    end
    ```

### battleaff <span class="new-badge">New</span> { #battleaff .command data-toc-label="battleaff" data-added="3.6" }

Makes the affliction a battle affliction: `regeneration`, `fastheal`, the Elixir of Health and vanilla's other cures also heal it, after the unit's vanilla battle afflictions. A unit's vanilla `affres`, its chance of not receiving a battle affliction, also applies to it. Without `battleaff`, only `cureoneaff` with the affliction's name or a Lua script cures it.

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    #!@battleaff
    ```

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    battleaff
    ```

### icon &lt;nbr&gt; | "./&lt;file&gt;" <span class="new-badge">New</span> { #icon .command data-toc-label="icon" data-added="3.10" }

Sets the affliction's icon on the unit stats screen, inside a `newaffliction` block. Without `icon`, the affliction uses the Diseased icon.

- **nbr:** A vanilla icon number from `res.trs` (for example, `32` for a gold star on a red disc, or `211` for Magic Shield).
- **file:** A 32 x 32 `.tga` or `.png` image in your mod's folder, starting with `./`.

<!-- vale CoE5SE.Reports = NO -->
An invalid number or missing file leaves the affliction with the Diseased icon (logged in `coe5mod.log`). A second mod's `icon` for the same affliction must match the first's, or it is ignored (logged in `coe5mod.log`).
<!-- vale CoE5SE.Reports = YES -->

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    icon 32
    ```

    Or a custom picture in your mod's folder:

    ```c5m
    icon "./fading.tga"
    ```

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    icon 32
    ```

    Or a custom picture in your mod's folder:

    ```c5se
    icon "./fading.tga"
    ```

## An affliction by string { #by-string }

Vanilla `makeaff`, `cureoneaff`, `+hasaffunithere`, `afftarg` and `affres` take your affliction by string, in place of the number. With a number, the command works as in vanilla.

| Command | Declared in | With your affliction |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `makeaff "<name>"` | An event | Gives the affliction to the target unit. |
| `cureoneaff "<name>"` | An event | Cures it on the target unit. |
| `+hasaffunithere <player> "<name>"` | An event | True if player has a unit in the current square that has the affliction. Also sets target unit (player `-1` = any player). |
| `afftarg "<name>"` | A ritual | Gives the affliction to the target unit. |
| `cureoneaff "<name>" <chance>` | A ritual | Has this chance of curing it on the target unit, 0 to 100. |
| `affres "<name>" <chance>` | A monster or magic item | Chance of not receiving the affliction, 0 to 1000. At 100 or more the unit never receives it. The chances of a unit's monster and its items add up. |

<!-- vale CoE5SE.Reports = NO -->
In a monster, magic item or ritual, declare the affliction above the line, or in a mod that loads first. A line naming an affliction no `newaffliction` declares silently does nothing, and as a trigger it is false (logged in `coe5mod.log`).
<!-- vale CoE5SE.Reports = YES -->

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    #!@makeaff "Marsh Fever"
    ```

    Or cured, in an event:

    ```c5m
    #!@cureoneaff "Marsh Fever"
    ```

    Or as a trigger:

    ```c5m
    #!@+hasaffunithere -2 "Marsh Fever"
    ```

    Or in a ritual:

    ```c5m
    #!@afftarg "Fading"
    ```

    Or cured, in a ritual:

    ```c5m
    #!@cureoneaff "Marsh Fever" 100
    ```

    Or resisted, on a monster or magic item:

    ```c5m
    #!@affres "Marsh Fever" 50
    ```

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    makeaff "Marsh Fever"
    ```

    Or cured, in an event:

    ```c5se
    cureoneaff "Marsh Fever"
    ```

    Or as a trigger:

    ```c5se
    +hasaffunithere -2 "Marsh Fever"
    ```

    Or in a ritual:

    ```c5se
    afftarg "Fading"
    ```

    Or cured, in a ritual:

    ```c5se
    cureoneaff "Marsh Fever" 100
    ```

    Or resisted, on a monster or magic item:

    ```c5se
    affres "Marsh Fever" 50
    ```

### Example afflictions { #example }

=== ".c5m"

    ```c5m
    #!@newaffliction "Marsh Fever"
    #!@descr "A fever from the foul airs of the Dead Marshes."
    #!@battleaff
    #!@end

    #!@newaffliction "Fading"
    #!@descr "A bearer of one of the Nine Rings. In time it will claim him."
    #!@end

    selectitem "Athelas"
    #!@affres "Marsh Fever" 50

    squareevent
    +squarename "The Dead Marshes"
    +chance 25
    +hasunithere -2 "Hobbit Archer"
    #!@makeaff "Marsh Fever"
    endevent

    squareevent
    +hasunithere -2 "Aragorn"
    #!@+hasaffunithere -2 "Marsh Fever"
    #!@cureoneaff "Marsh Fever"
    message -2 "Aragorn tends one of the sick with athelas."
    endevent

    newritual "Hands of the King"
    descr "The hands of the king are the hands of a healer. One of the army is cured of Marsh Fever."
    level 1
    choosefxtarg 0
    #!@cureoneaff "Marsh Fever" 100

    newritual "Gift of the Nine"
    descr "Sauron gives one of the Nine Rings to one of his own, who begins to fade."
    level 3
    choosefxtarg 0
    #!@afftarg "Fading"
    ```

=== ".c5se"

    ```c5se
    newaffliction "Marsh Fever"
    descr "A fever from the foul airs of the Dead Marshes."
    battleaff
    end

    newaffliction "Fading"
    descr "A bearer of one of the Nine Rings. In time it will claim him."
    end

    selectitem "Athelas"
    affres "Marsh Fever" 50

    squareevent
    +squarename "The Dead Marshes"
    +chance 25
    +hasunithere -2 "Hobbit Archer"
    makeaff "Marsh Fever"
    endevent

    squareevent
    +hasunithere -2 "Aragorn"
    +hasaffunithere -2 "Marsh Fever"
    cureoneaff "Marsh Fever"
    message -2 "Aragorn tends one of the sick with athelas."
    endevent

    newritual "Hands of the King"
    descr "The hands of the king are the hands of a healer. One of the army is cured of Marsh Fever."
    level 1
    choosefxtarg 0
    cureoneaff "Marsh Fever" 100

    newritual "Gift of the Nine"
    descr "Sauron gives one of the Nine Rings to one of his own, who begins to fade."
    level 3
    choosefxtarg 0
    afftarg "Fading"
    ```
